records.reason: Report explicitly attributes the observed marrow edema to microtrabecular injuries caused by a stated recent knee injury. Primary MRI studies describe microtrabecular trauma and subcortical trabecular fractures as bone-contusion/bone-bruise terminology. In this source no discrete fracture line or cortical disruption is described. Accept the explicit traumatic marrow-injury diagnosis as report-level contusion evidence, without claiming image confirmation.
